description: Get complete Figma design data with full layout, styling, Flexbox primitives, and component relationships. SVG assets are automatically saved to a temp folder referenced in the response.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to fetch, often found in a provided URL like figma.com/(file|design)/<fileKey>/...

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to fetch, often found as URL parameter node-id=<nodeId>, always use if provided. Use format '1234:5678' or 'I5666:180910;1:10515;1:10336' for multiple nodes.

resolveVariables.description: Whether to resolve variable references to their actual values. Set to false if already fetched once.

svgOutputDir.description: Directory to save SVG assets to. Defaults to system temp directory.

name: get_figma_design
title: Get Figma Design
